answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the ripple of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Written in a practical systems telemetry descriptions, crisp technical observations register, it stays short. The kernel holds work receipts rather than names, so the karst of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
